mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_log (id, trace_id, actor_id, on_behalf_of, action, object_type, object_id, object_version, before_digest, after_digest, reason, ip, user_agent, occurred_at, created_at) VALUES (#{entry.id}, #{entry.traceId}, #{entry.actorId}, #{entry.onBehalfOf}, #{entry.action}, #{entry.objectType}, #{entry.objectId}, #{entry.objectVersion}, #{entry.beforeDigest}, #{entry.afterDigest}, #{entry.reason}, #{entry.ip}, #{entry.userAgent}, #{entry.occurredAt}, now()) ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING
